options.content:
### Tray roster — which GB300 trays are reporting
One row per tray, straight from the tray's own agents. A tray counts as *reporting* when its `node_exporter` has delivered a sample within the scrape lookback; *silent* means it delivered something in the last 24 h but nothing in the last 10 minutes. Every table is filterable — click the funnel in a column header.

**This board owns the tray-by-tray coverage detail** — the roster, the silent list and the per-rack roll-up. Headline counts also appear on the [Executive board](/d/nvis-executive), which owns the Scale-Unit estate roll-up.  ·  [Host faults — filesystem, load, memory, kernel](/d/nvis-l2-node-deep-dive)  ·  [Tray deep dive — one tray in full](/d/nvis-node-deep-dive)  ·  [GPU health — XID, ECC, thermal](/d/gpu-health)
